content.title: Detroit Tigers vs. Boston Red Sox: Preview & How to Stream
content.text: Sunday’s series finale at Fenway Park has been rescheduled to a later start time. The game will be broadcast locally on Detroit SportsNet (DSN) and NESN. First pitch is now scheduled for 4:35 PM ET. Fans can stream the game in high definition on Fubo, which offers access to regional sports networks and national MLB coverage.CategoryDetailsDateSunday, April 19, 2026First Pitch4:35 PM ET / 1:35 PM PTTV ChannelDSN / NESN / FuboLive StreamFuboVenueFenway Park, Boston, MAThe Detroit Tigers (11-10) look to secure a series victory at Fenway Park this Sunday, April 19, against the Boston Red Sox (8-12). After a rain-delayed start pushed the game back to late afternoon, both teams are eager to establish momentum. Detroit has been surprisingly competitive on the road, while Boston is desperate to right the ship after a difficult opening stretch to the 2026 season. The Tigers’ offense relies heavily on their platoon advantages under manager A.J. Hinch. While stars like Riley Greene anchor the lineup, the team will look to Matt Vierling and Jahmai Jones to provide a spark against the Red Sox's left-handed starter. Boston counters with a lineup featuring Rafael Devers and rookie sensation Roman Anthony, hoping to ignite a Fenway crowd that has seen a streaky offensive performance so far this April. Catch every pitch live on Fubo. The pitching duel features a battle of southpaws. Detroit turns to the veteran Framber Valdez (1-1), who has been a pillar of consistency with a 3.75 ERA. He faces off against Boston’s Garrett Crochet (2-2), who is looking for a bounce-back performance after a rocky outing in his last start. Despite a high 7.58 ERA, Crochet’s elite strikeout stuff remains a major threat to any lineup. You can witness this American League clash streaming live on Fubo.A major storyline for Detroit involves navigating injuries to their infield depth, with Zach McKinstry currently sidelined. For Boston, the primary focus is supporting their pitching staff; the Sox are 0-8 when their starters allow four or more runs. Finding a rhythm early will be key for Crochet to prevent a Tigers breakout. Fubo is your home for the complete broadcast.Tigers vs. Red Sox Betting Odds & PredictionsThe Red Sox enter the series finale as slight home favorites.
